name: com.coffeebean.pooling
description: Object pooling module for the CoffeeBean framework: pure-C# generic pool (CPool<T>) and GameObject prefab pool (CGameObjectPool) with lifecycle callbacks and delayed auto-return. Standalone, no dependencies.
